capture: Every token recorded after processing: 256 actual time steps. SVD/quantization diagnostics use four checkpoints. No interpolation or synthetic frames.

metadata.token_semantics: states[t-1] is the state AFTER processing token_ids[t-1], positions start at 1
limitations: FP16/BF16 weights and activations with native FP32 state, not an all-FP32 model.
Teacher-forced document tokens; no generation, no padding, no repeated text.
Single-token and chunked mixed-precision execution can differ numerically.
GPU memory includes weights/current cache/temporaries; CPU history is separate.
State probes and transfers are included in speed; not a model throughput benchmark.

validation.note: Prefix tolerances are numerical smoke checks, not a proof of bitwise equivalence or model accuracy.

zero_point_diagnostic.scope: Additional offline diagnostic on the same L8/H0/t256 state; not a new model run
